scientific_integrity: Proof given by Cartesian-product facet/face-lattice orthogonality and projection factorization. Exact rational example is supportive only and is not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The conjecture remains open for general indecomposable polytopes of dimension at least four; results require mutually orthogonal Euclidean factor spaces and factor points in their orthogonal kernels. Historical priority under alternate terminology remains provisional.
title: Orthogonal products preserve bipolar cutouts and extend Thales tilings to arbitrary dimensions
